req.title: Return 404 for unknown routes
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 for any path not matching a defined route.

doc.reasoning: R-HTTPBIN-036 requires that any path not matching a defined route returns HTTP 404. Tests must cover: (1) a clearly unknown path returns 404 (positive/EP), (2) a known valid route returns 200 not 404 (negative/EP to test both sides of the condition), (3) boundary paths that are one character off from real routes (BVA), (4) various HTTP methods on unknown routes (DT), and (5) deeply nested unknown paths (NEG). Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status code 404 (not >= 400), testing both sides (known=200, unknown=404), and using multiple distinct unknown paths to catch constant/comparison mutations.

tests.name: test_unknown_route_returns_404
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Path /this-route-does-not-exist is not registered
actions: Create Flask test client from httpbin.core.app
Send GET request to /this-route-does-not-exist
expected: HTTP response status code is exactly 404
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_unknown_route_returns_404():
    r = client.get('/this-route-does-not-exist')
    assert r.status_code == 404

test_unknown_route_returns_404()

tests.name: test_path_with_trailing_slash_on_unknown_route_returns_404

Path /get/ (with trailing slash) is not a registered route or redirects
actions: Create Flask test client from httpbin.core.app
Send GET request to /get/ with follow_redirects=False
expected: HTTP response status code is either 404 or 308 (redirect), not 200
trace: R-HTTPBIN-036: trailing slash boundary on known route base; must not return 200
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_path_with_trailing_slash_on_unknown_route_returns_404():
    r = client.get('/get/', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code in (404, 308, 301, 302)

test_path_with_trailing_slash_on_unknown_route_returns_404()
